title: Example Statement of Advice: Scaled advice for a new client
subject: This guide provides an example Statement of Advice (SOA) for scaled personal advice on personal insurance for a new retail client. It demonstrates how AFS licensees and advisers can structure an SOA that meets legislative requirements when providing limited-scope advice.
background: The guide is issued under ASIC's powers to administer the Corporations Act 2001 (Cth), particularly the obligations for providing personal advice to retail clients. It is intended for AFS licensees, authorised representatives, and advisers who give personal advice, and was developed in consultation with stakeholders to illustrate compliant scaled advice documentation.
ruling: ASIC provides an example SOA to demonstrate how advisers can meet the legislative requirements for personal advice when the scope is limited (scaled advice). The example shows how to structure an SOA for a new client seeking advice only on personal insurance, including sections on client information, advice scope, recommendations, product comparisons, fees and commissions, and authority to proceed. ASIC emphasises that the example is illustrative and not exhaustive, and that advisers must ensure their SOAs are tailored to the client's circumstances and comply with all relevant obligations under the Corporations Act. The guide also highlights the importance of clear communication about costs, conflicts of interest, and the limited nature of the advice.
